name: Joe's iOS Builds
subtitle: OpenNOW, VoidLink, ChargeLens, and Husk builds

apps.name: Husk
apps.developerName: Husk contributors; local build by Joe
apps.localizedDescription: Husk 0.6.1 (build 12) fixes iPad touch input: uses the known mouse-compatible touch path by default, restoring taps and drags. The direct-touch option remains experimental. Keeps an aspect-matched iPad Android panel at a bounded ~0.3-megapixel workload. First launch cold-boots Android once to save a snapshot matching the virtual touchscreen/display hardware; existing Android files are retained. Built from Leviidev/Husk commit 65d0d122a139fa7ed53db6df84ed6737e3216d29. Requires JIT. Unsigned IPA.

apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 (Experimental)
apps.localizedDescription: Build 173 (1.1.173) adds an opt-in in-stream Metal Performance HUD using CAMetalLayer developer HUD controls. The HUD shows the display's supported refresh range, presented FPS, frame intervals, and GPU time; timing logs are enabled with the overlay. Use it to compare client presentation cadence with stream FPS. This is client-side evidence and does not establish server-side Cloud G-Sync acknowledgement. Includes the Metal 4 triple-buffer renderer fix and NVST/CloudMatch G-Sync request wiring. Unsigned Release IPA for KravaSigner.

apps.name: VoidLink PyroWave
apps.localizedDescription: VoidLink contributors; local PyroWave build with mouse and desktop scaling changes.

apps.name: ChargeLens
apps.localizedDescription: Charging sensor app for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 26+). Live input watts, volts and amps, separate battery watts, graphs, saved sessions and CSV export. Correct device-specific sensor labels and a wider iPad landscape layout. Reads this device’s private hardware sensors; availability depends on the device and OS. 26 tests passed on each simulator. Unsigned IPA for installer signing.
